title: VerifyCompletionStatus
description: Result of the library rebar.llm.verify_completion_status() / MCP verify_completion_status: the read-only currency of a ticket's completion-verifier attestation, with no LLM or network. verdict is `certified` only when the attestation is valid right now, otherwise the close-gate classifier reason (`stale-reopened`, `stale-material`, `not-closed`, `unsigned`, ...); `ok` tracks the same currency. verified_at_sha and signed_at are null when no readable attestation exists.

signed_at.description: Nanoseconds since the Unix epoch; a decimal STRING on the MCP wire when outside the JS-safe integer range (bug 6fe7).
